fixed.summary: A mount whose document uses a component without a prop that component declares data-required now returns an error naming the instance and the prop (`row.svelte:2: <Card> leaves out its prop 'orientation', which it requires (data-required)`). It used to return ok and build nothing, with a misleading 'not a row variable' message only in the warnings. Every other prop may be left out (ui-props-have-defaults).
